description: Linear aesthetic head over an image embedding. Explicitly a PRIOR: the ranking engine reweights it per user from PrefEvents, so it must never be treated as ground truth.

normalisation.calibration_note: Head emits a 1-10 rating. Rescaled linearly to [0,1] for the contract's Unit; raw_value is retained on the Score so a recalibration needs no re-run.

notes: Consumes an embedding, not pixels, so it is nearly free once SigLIP has run -- which is why the pipeline orders embedding before aesthetic. The original head was trained on CLIP ViT-L/14 features; running it on SigLIP 2 features requires retraining the linear head, and until that is done this entry is a placeholder for the shape of the config rather than a working model.
